original_test_intent: Read and validate current chassis power state, last power event, miscellaneous state and optional front-panel capability/status from the intended BMC without changing chassis state.
original_method: Issue Chassis NetFn command 0x00/0x01 with no request data and inspect the documented response bytes; source references an internal Script.
manual_activity: Owner supplies the approved expected power/event state, optional-byte interpretation and evidence-redaction policy once.
safety_requirements: Do not put password in argv/evidence
Validate minimum and optional response length
agent_execution_scope: Archive redacted evidence without follow-on control

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DeepSeek is directionally correct but unsafe in credential handling and incomplete because generic chassis-status text is not the source byte-level acceptance oracle.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use protected credential injection for one raw 0x00/0x01 read, validate and decode the complete response, then use high-level chassis status only as a cross-check.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The raw command, documented byte fields, Script URL and 10/5 timing remain preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Perform one secret-safe read with strict completion/length/bitfield validation and compare decoded state to the authoritative Project baseline.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds deterministic field acceptance and safe credentials while retaining the source command and optional-byte semantics.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Command completion or unparsed status text does not prove correct power/event/front-panel fields and does not test any chassis-control function.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A wrong target or parser can report an incorrect power/event state and make later disruptive decisions unsafe.

project_override_considerations: A high-level/vendor status API is equivalent only if engineer-approved and it exposes all source fields with equal freshness and target identity; omitted raw-byte coverage remains explicit.
expected_evidence: Verified target/SUT and approved power/event baseline
Redacted no-data request and complete response

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The raw command and response map align with the title; Criteria is incomplete but not contradictory.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The read operation is explicit. Baseline, optional-byte policy and redaction are execution-readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Replaces unparsed user judgment with deterministic status decoding, protects credentials and prevents a read result from authorizing a power action.
independent_technical_reasoning: Last Power Event and Miscellaneous Chassis State are bitfields that can retain history independent of current power. They must be decoded and compared separately; an expected current-power bit cannot be used to accept stale or contradictory event/front-panel fields, and no returned state permits an automatic control command.
